pages.text: Ligands split a metal's d orbitals by $(thing)Δ$(); against the pairing energy $(thing)P$(), that decides high spin or low. The $(item)Coordination Reactor$() sets the ligand field: $(item)Prussian Blue$() and the $(item)Porphyrin Oxygen Carrier$() are low spin, the $(item)Copper Ammine Complex$() high. The porphyrin is haem: it holds oxygen and lets it go.
$(item)EDTA$() grips a metal with six bonds. In the $(item)Chelation Column$() it pulls rare earths out of brine, and cleans spent fuel salt back into fuel - so long as the flow does not saturate it.
